title.description: Card heading. Becomes the dialog trigger when details is set.

media.description: Image or visual at the top. Zooms slightly on hover.

action.description: Trailing footer control, such as a button.

avatar.description: Small leading visual in the footer, such as the owner's avatar.

meta.description: Who the card belongs to, shown in the byline.

status.description: Short status under the meta, such as "Updated 2 hours ago". Changes roll in word by word and are announced politely.

details.description: Quick look content. When set, the card opens into a larger Radix dialog.

defaultOpen.description: Initial quick look state when uncontrolled.

onOpenChange.description: Called when the quick look opens or closes.
